title: Blue Heron Bliss Cottage | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This spacious 4 bed, 4 bath Rosemary Beach cottage rentals offers a stunning 4200 sq. ft. layout. Click here to see inside Blue Heron Bliss Cottage and book a stay!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Blue Heron Bliss overlooks the beautiful lawn and Town Center of the charming community of Rosemary Beach south of 30A, yet is also a few easy steps down the boardwalk to endless ocean views. New owners of 88 N. Spanish Town Lane have created a spacious paradise for guests with or without children to enjoy. The three-story home resides with its newly renovated exterior with classic Bevelo lantern lighting, and bright, welcoming interiors that feature large design features combined with coastal style, perfect for bringing family and friends together under one roof. With 5 bedrooms - two of which are master suites - 5.5 baths, a private courtyard, wrap around deck and private carriage house, this Rosemary Beach getaway is fitting for both families with small children as well as adults seeking a private beach holiday.

Exquisite details adorn this home from the first floor to the third: vintage iron staircase, large open concept living area, rich hardwood floors, rustic wood beams and water fall feature in the outdoor courtyard. Children can play in the large fenced in patio on the ground floor while adults enjoy the view from the private 2nd floor balcony. The gourmet kitchen is a dream for festive or lazy gatherings in the kitchen, with all the cook’s tools like the comforts of home. Coming in and out from a day at the beach is a breeze with the private shower accessible from the patio through the spacious laundry room and half bath. Blue Heron Bliss is where your next beach vacation memories will be made!

Garage Parking for 1 vehicle.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
